name: shader-neuro-noise
title: Neuro Noise
description: A web of glowing filaments that slowly morphs, in three colors over a dark field, drawn in WebGL.
useWhen: An AI, ML or tech scene wants an organic neural-web texture that reads as intelligence.
You want slow morphing structure behind text without hard geometry.
The palette is dark and you want a filamentary web to sit low-contrast in the back.
avoidWhen: You want smooth cloud noise instead of web filaments: use shader-perlin-noise or shader-simplex-noise.
The brief is playful or warm: neuro-noise reads technical.
Bright filaments would fight small text: lower `brightness` and `contrast`.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Mid color
variables.description: Color of the softer glow around them.

variables.label: Contrast
variables.description: How sharply the filaments stand out.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the shader in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
